findings.notes: A namespaced Policy's apiCall urlPath was clamped to the policy's own namespace by normalising the path before comparing it, but the normalisation did not decode percent-encoded characters. Encoded dot-segments therefore survived normalisation and escaped the clamp, letting a namespace tenant read resources in other namespaces and create cluster-scoped objects as the admission controller's ServiceAccount. The fix decodes the path once before normalising it, so validation sees the same path the API server would. Cluster-scoped policies are unaffected. Commit 74e022737.
